title: Concrete: specialty-scoped contractor identity with paving and materials exclusions
hypothesis: An active, concrete-scoped contractor record can establish business and principal or license-role candidate evidence, but its published phone is only a business-contact candidate. An owner-confirmed mobile requires independent owner evidence plus mobile, live, DNC, suppression, and delivery-dedupe gates.
ownerSource: Legally eligible contractor registers with an explicit concrete classification: WA L&I active CONCRET specialty rows and CA CSLB C-8 master/personnel records. A WA primary principal or CSLB personnel title is candidate-role evidence, not ownership confirmation.
phoneSource: A published register business phone, contrasted with a current Maps business listing where permitted. It remains a business or candidate contact until exclusivity, mobile, live, DNC, global suppression/dedupe, and independent owner-evidence gates pass.

workflow.label: State legal gate
workflow.detail: Allow only a legally eligible public contractor-register route; retain WA's PDDL/RCW caution and hold prohibited or restricted list routes.

workflow.label: Active concrete-specialty register
workflow.detail: Require an active explicit concrete classification such as WA CONCRET or CA C-8; generic construction registration is not concrete evidence.

workflow.label: Permitted concrete listing fallback
workflow.detail: Use the live Maps concrete-contractor route only where the register route is unavailable or not yet implemented and the fallback is permitted.

workflow.label: Hold restricted source
workflow.detail: Do not ingest prohibited or commercially restricted list sources.

workflow.label: Concrete and operator-fit filter
workflow.detail: Require concrete installation, repair, flatwork, foundations, slabs, or driveway evidence; hold ready-mix suppliers, cement/material retail, aggregate/hauling, pure asphalt/pavers, excavation-only, structural-commercial, franchise, stale, and multi-location matches.

workflow.label: Hold off-segment candidate
workflow.detail: Do not convert an adjacent trade, supplier, or industrial operator into an independent concrete-owner candidate.

workflow.label: Owner-role assessment
workflow.detail: Retain an Individual entity, Sole Owner, partner, or member as stronger candidate evidence; principal, qualifier, RMO, RME, officer, or corporate role needs independent owner evidence.

workflow.label: Hold unsupported role
workflow.detail: Do not label a qualifier, employee, corporate officer, or unsupported principal as the business owner.

workflow.label: Candidate contact contrast
workflow.detail: Compare published register and Maps numbers where both exist; missing, shared, duplicate, or office-only numbers do not become direct owner contacts.

workflow.label: Hold unsupported contact
workflow.detail: Do not infer a private mobile or call a public business line an owner handset.

workflow.label: Contact and compliance gates
workflow.detail: Apply mobile line type, live status, DNC, global suppression/dedupe, and independent owner-evidence checks.

workflow.label: Hold failed verification
workflow.detail: Park non-mobile, unreachable, suppressed, shared, or ownership-unsupported cases.

workflow.label: Deliver supported classification
workflow.detail: Deliver only after every required gate passes; owner-confirmed mobile requires independent owner evidence.

edges.label: supplier, adjacent, brand, industrial, or stale
all contact and owner-evidence gates pass
line, compliance, dedupe, or owner-evidence failure

failures.risk: The live Maps-first concrete-contractor route begins with an advertised business line rather than trade-scoped identity.
failures.mitigation: Use a legally eligible CONCRET/C-8 record as trade and candidate-role evidence, then use Maps as contrast or permitted fallback.

failures.risk: WA CONCRET and CA C-8 classifications cannot be selected from ingested rows because adapters do not persist specialty/classification into the field consumed by register-source filters.
failures.mitigation: Persist normalized classifications in a filterable trade field, or implement source-specific class filtering before adding concrete register mappings.

failures.risk: Ready-mix, cement and aggregate suppliers, hauling, asphalt/pavers, excavation-only work, and industrial structural contractors enter the independent concrete route.
failures.mitigation: Require explicit concrete contractor/flatwork/foundation/driveway activity and hold adjacent, supplier, industrial, franchise, and multi-location cases.

failures.risk: A principal, qualifier, or public office line is represented as an owner-confirmed mobile.
failures.mitigation: Preserve source role and phone provenance; require contact, compliance, and independent owner-evidence gates.

failures.risk: Texas and North Carolina are treated as statewide concrete-license routes although the research marks concrete unlicensed statewide there.
failures.mitigation: Do not fabricate a statewide concrete-register path; use only a permitted business-listing fallback or separately reviewed local route.

iterations.hypothesis: A free, active concrete-specialty register can contribute trade and candidate-contact coverage before any owner classification.
iterations.test: Aggregate-only live query of 20 WA L&I rows on 2026-09-24 where statuscode was A and specialtycode1desc contained CONCRET.
iterations.observed: 20/20 rows were active and had specialty, primary principal, and published-phone fields; 3/20 were Individual business entities. The observation establishes field coverage only, not owner role, handset ownership, mobile status, reachability, DNC, or delivery.
iterations.change: Use an explicit specialty branch and role/contact holds. Do not treat the principal or published phone as owner-confirmed; first repair class persistence so the current runtime can select concrete rows.

measurement.result: WA L&I m8qx-ubtq active rows whose specialtycode1desc contained CONCRET: 20/20 active, 20/20 specialty present, 20/20 primaryprincipalname present, 20/20 phonenumber present, and 3/20 businesstypecodedesc = Individual. Aggregate-only observation; no names, phones, addresses, license numbers, or business names retained. It does not measure mobile status, reachability, DNC, ownership confirmation, handset ownership, or delivery.

cost.note: No clean delivered owner contact was measured. Historical concrete brain rates use a different denominator and are not a per-clean cost for this workflow.

implementation.summary: The live recipe-A concrete discovery and generic relevance classifier exist, and WA/CA contractor adapters are present. Concrete has no register-source mapping, and the adapters do not retain CONCRET/C-8 classification in the field used by pullNames filtering, so no specialty-scoped concrete register route can run today.

nextMeasurement: Add synthetic WA CONCRET and non-CONCRET rows plus CA C-8 and non-C-8 master/personnel rows. Verify a concrete job selects only the explicit concrete class, preserves principal/personnel as candidate-role evidence, holds supplier/paving/asphalt/excavation/industrial/adjacent listings, and cannot deliver an owner-confirmed contact without independent evidence. After authorization, measure mobile, live, DNC-cleared, reached-owner, and delivered outcomes with separate denominators.
